summary: 把事件來源、程式信任程度、token權限與密鑰可見性畫成矩陣，分開測試與發布工作。
summaryEn: Map event source, code trust, token permissions and secret visibility; separate test jobs from release jobs.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 對外部分支事件檢查密鑰不可見且不執行具有發布權的任意程式；保存事件範例與預期矩陣。

optionsEn: Verify that external-branch events cannot see secrets or execute arbitrary code with release privileges; retain event fixtures.
Interpolating untrusted event strings into shell code can alter meaning; use harmless special-character fixtures to test quoting and data passing.

This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Three test jobs each receive eight action permissions but need only two read-only actions; assess release separately.

steps.instruction:
將不可信事件字串直接插入shell可改變命令語意；本課只用無害特殊字元測試引號與資料傳遞。
對照「事件信任矩陣」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。發布權限限可信分支與獨立核驗工作，第三方action需固定可核查版本；不把高權工作開給任意PR。
本階段必須重驗：把事件來源、程式信任程度、token權限與密鑰可見性畫成矩陣，分開測試與發布工作。
steps.instructionEn:
Interpolating untrusted event strings into shell code can alter meaning; use harmless special-character fixtures to test quoting and data passing.
Against the nominal Event trust matrix result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Restrict release permissions to trusted branches and separate checks; pin reviewable action versions and exclude arbitrary PRs from privileged jobs.
Reverify this criterion: Map event source, code trust, token permissions and secret visibility; separate test jobs from release jobs.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。將不可信事件字串直接插入shell可改變命令語意；本課只用無害特殊字元測試引號與資料傳遞。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Interpolating untrusted event strings into shell code can alter meaning; use harmless special-character fixtures to test quoting and data passing.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
